findings.title: Inventory does not canonicalise SKUs, so stock keyed in lower case is invisible to orders
findings.why: The README says SKUs are case-insensitive and ignore surrounding spaces. This change makes `Catalog.find` use `canonicalSku`, and orders now pass canonical SKUs to the inventory. But `Inventory.restock`, `adjust`, `available`, `onHand` and `movements` still key their maps on the raw string. So `restock('mug-01', 10)` or `restock(' MUG-01', 10)` stores the units under a key that orders never read. An order for `MUG-01` is then refused as out of stock. `lowStock` and `movements` have the same gap for non-canonical input.
